BLUEPRINT:1,20,2203,2205,0,0,0,0,639302625329742648,0.10.35.29151,Everything%20Farm%207,,,,This%20is%20the%20seventh%20BP%20in%20the%20%22Everything%20Farm%22%20BP%20but%20it%20doesn%27t%20have%20to%20be%20the%20last%20one%20that%20gets%20placed.%0A%0AIf%20you%20place%2022%20of%20these%20BPs%20across%20the%20planet%20then%20with%20100%25%20wind%20and%20solar%20on%20the%20planet%20this%20BP%20will%20generate%20about%203.5GW%20-%20each%20BP%20generates%20roughly%20320%20MW%2C%20but%20if%20you%20have%2022%20on%20the%20planet%20only%20half%20have%20light%20at%20any%20point%2C%20so%20it%27s%20basically%20160%20MW%20x%2022.%20%0A%0A22%20of%20these%20BP%20will%20use%20about%201GW%20of%20power%20to%20operate%20all%20the%20Shield%20Generators%2C%20PLS%2C%20BAB%2C%20lasers%2C%20and%20bots%2Fbelts%2Fsorters%20so%20it%20leaves%20you%20plenty%20of%20leftover%20power%20to%20do%20whatever%20you%20want%20at%20the%20poles.%20%0A%0AWhile%20this%20is%20the%20%22last%22%20in%20the%20series%2C%20it%20can%20be%20placed%20at%20any%20point%20-%20the%20only%20techs%20it%20requires%20are%20solar%20panels%20and%20wind%20turbines%20which%20unlock%20very%20early%20-%20it%20SHOULDN%27T%20be%20placed%20until%20both%20DF%20based%20from%20the%20first%20BP%20have%20landed.%20If%20you%20place%20this%20before%20they%20land%2C%20then%20when%20they%20land%20they%20will%20destroy%20about%2020%20solar%20panels%20each.%20So%20wait%20until%20they%20land%2C%20then%20place%20this.%20The%20BP%20accounts%20for%20how%20the%20planetary%20base%20grows%20and%20the%20dark%20fog%20units%20won%27t%20attack%20these%20as%20they%20head%20for%20the%20signal%20towers%20first%20due%20to%20the%20mechanics%20of%20the%20game.""A8D0D96AEF9BDF0FFC5DC11402A7B99D
